info.title: Kiorex Marketplace API
info.description: Platform connector for Kiorex (KX-01). Authenticate with HMAC headers. v1.2.0 (KX-09 Rev 2.3, additive): provider sync profession/edition/home-visit fields, serviceLocation+district on slots, visitAddress on holds, 422 OUT_OF_COVERAGE, care-plan-requests (P3 draft). The same client serves both Kiorly editions (Clinic and Nurse). v1.4.0 (contracts 1.10.0, additive): optional signed `acquisition` block on POST /bookings (growth attribution evidence, ARCH section 6.7); a Clinic that does not know it ignores it and treats the booking as UNATTRIBUTED; booking GET and every response are unchanged. v1.5.0 (contracts 1.11.0, additive): optional Clinic link token `lt` on POST /bookings (GRW-P1-C/D1: a valid, unexpired token of an ACTIVE referral link of the booking organisation makes the booking provider-led; it can only remove a commission); signed link-registry lookup `GET /referral-links/{code}` and reconciliation list `GET /referral-links` (a code is known to Kiorex before its first token; revocations are visible). v1.6.0 (contracts 1.12.0, additive): booking `channel` accepts KIOREX_WHATSAPP; the Kiorex pay-link registration call is documented (`POST /pay/links`, hosted on Kiorex, called by Kiorly); provider listings may declare `modalities` including VIDEO; events WAITLIST_OFFER_CREATED/EXPIRED, optional Rx `items[]` and optional `followUp.intervalDays` on the visit summary; waitlist join/leave and slot capacity were already documented in 1.1.0 and are unchanged. Rewards never reach the clinic: no referral or reward field exists on any marketplace call. Rev 2.6 additions (still 1.6.0, additive): signed promotion commands `POST /promotions/{promotionId}/reserve` and `/release` (provider-sponsored promotions, P2-S: the clinic funds its own discount, it is never a Kiorex discount), optional `sponsoredDiscount` block on `POST /bookings`, optional `tender` on the two deposit-paid calls (gross and funding sources, never a patient identity). Rev 2.7 addition (still 1.6.0, additive): signed `POST /commission-collections` (COM-1: Kiorex reports a commission collection run to the provider's transparency view; idempotent on runId, newest version wins; money is never held by Kiorly).

channel.description: CLINIC_LINK when booked from the clinic's own booking page (KX-09); never commissioned. KIOREX_WHATSAPP (1.6.0): booked in the Kiorex WhatsApp assistant; commissioned like MARKETPLACE unless PROVIDER_LED evidence applies. A Clinic that does not accept it answers 400 and Kiorex falls back to MARKETPLACE with attribution.source=kiorex_whatsapp.

bookingPageSlug.description: Slug of the clinic/doctor booking page (KX-09)

attribution.description: Existing free-form display attribution ({source: 'kiorex' | 'kiorex_whatsapp', searchId, campaign, landingPage}); kept as is, never used for commission evidence.

lt.description: Signed link-touch token issued by the Clinic for a provider referral link, QR or widget (`<base64url claims>.<base64url hmac>`, claims {o: organisation, c: 8-character link code, t: issued-at ms, v: 1}, 72 h lifetime; domain-separated HMAC over `kx-lt1\n` + payload). Kiorex forwards the token it verified at decision time and only when the signed `acquisition.origin` is PROVIDER_LED. The Clinic re-checks the link at booking time (ACTIVE, same organisation); an invalid, expired, other-organisation or revoked token is ignored (the booking is then not attributed to the link) and is never an error. Optional and additive: absent = today's rules. Never a patient or visitor identifier.

400.description: BOOKING_PAGE_MISMATCH when the slug belongs to another clinic or doctor; ACQUISITION_BLOCK_INVALID or ACQUISITION_EVIDENCE_HASH_INVALID when the optional acquisition block is malformed

422.description: OUT_OF_COVERAGE after a zone change (release the hold, show in-zone alternatives); the address is carried from the hold

post.summary: KNLAB01 (Nurse edition, contracts 1.6.0): Kiorex relays the lab's status for a hand-off, with the sanitized chain of custody and (on release) the secure link
post.description: Idempotent; the headline `status` is monotonic (a stale push answers 200 applied:false). `orderId` is the Kiorly LabOrderPlaced orderId (the ClinicalOrder id). Carries no results and no PHI: a status, custody events (type, time, temperature, NURSE|LAB) and, when RELEASED, reportId + secure link.

200.description: Applied, or already applied. Body {applied:boolean,status}: applied=false when a stale push would have moved the status backwards (custody still refreshes).

get.summary: Signed lookup of one referral link (link registry)
get.description: Kiorex asks the Clinic which organisation owns a link code and whether it is still active. Authenticated like every marketplace call (HMAC). Returns the same record the `ReferralLinkCreated` and `ReferralLinkRevoked` events carry, so a code is known to Kiorex before its first token and a revocation can be read back after a missed event. No patient data.

404.description: REFERRAL_LINK_NOT_FOUND: no link with this code exists

get.description: Links created or changed since a timestamp, oldest first, for the periodic reconciliation that repairs a missed event. Cursor pagination.

post.summary: Kiorly registers a deposit pay link with Kiorex Pay (product-key HMAC, kiorly-clinic only)
post.description: Documented in 1.6.0 (it has been implemented in Kiorex since PAY-03). Idempotent on `token`. Kiorex later calls POST /deposit-links/{token}/paid when the patient pays.

201.description: Link registered (token, clinicId, amountMinor, currency, status OPEN|PAID|EXPIRED, expiresAt)

403.description: PRODUCT_NOT_ALLOWED: only Kiorly Clinic may register pay links

post.summary: Kiorex asks the Clinic to hold budget of a provider-sponsored promotion for one booking (signed, idempotent)
post.description: The Clinic re-checks status, window, eligibility, per-patient limit and writes a RESERVE entry against the budget cap; WALLET_ONLY also needs wallet cover. The reservation lives as long as the hold plus a grace and is released by a sweeper. The wallet is not touched until the visit completes.

post.summary: Kiorex releases a reservation (hold expired, booking cancelled or not confirmed)

200.description: Released (idempotent; an unknown or already released reservation answers 200)

post.summary: Kiorex reports the organization's commission rate view (COM-2, contracts 1.13.0): default per organization type, own rate, history. Read-only in the Clinic. Idempotent, the newest version wins; a malformed view is refused whole.
Kiorex signed status / marketplace outbox receiver (KX-05)
post.description: Kiorly POSTs JSON envelopes when `KIOREX_OUTBOX_WEBHOOK_URL` is configured. Dedupe on `eventId` (same id = at-most-once processing on Kiorex side).

parameters.name: X-Kiorly-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC sha256 of `${timestamp}.${body}` with shared secret

Profession.description: ADR-029. Extensible by market pack: consumers must tolerate unknown values.

Edition.description: Organization.edition (ADR-031). Same API and client for both editions.

ServiceLocation.description: VisitType.serviceLocation (ADR-030). VIDEO is reserved and not part of this contract.

VisitAddress.description: Patient home address. Sent only on holds for HOME visit types; encrypted at rest and masked after 24 h by Kiorly. Never appears in events or analytics (district only).

district.description: District code from the provider's coverageDistricts[].

register.description: Professional register that verified the clinician (e.g. a syndicate register for the profession, KX-05 PRVER01).

ProviderV23Fields.description: Fields added to each item of GET /providers in v1.2.0 (KX-09 Rev 2.3). All optional for backward compatibility; Kiorly Clinic emits them from v2.3.

serviceLocations.description: Locations the provider offers; HOME only when clinic.home_visits is effective.

coverageDistricts.description: District codes served for HOME visits. District-level only; no polygons or coordinates.

assignsClinician.description: Agencies only: the agency assigns a clinician after booking (HOME_VISIT_ASSIGNED event).

modalities.description: Care modalities the listing offers (additive, 1.6.0). VIDEO means the provider offers telemedicine; absent = IN_CLINIC (and HOME_VISIT per serviceLocations).

ProviderList.description: Paged provider profiles. Existing fields are unchanged; only the v2.3 additions are described here and the item schema tolerates additional properties.

Slot.description: Bookable slot. startsAt/endsAt are unchanged; v1.2.0 adds serviceLocation and district.

district.description: District code for HOME slots; null/absent for IN_CLINIC.

SlotHoldRequest.description: visitAddress is optional in the schema but REQUIRED by Kiorly for visit types whose serviceLocation is HOME (422 otherwise).

alternatives.description: In-zone alternatives, when Kiorly can offer them.

OutOfCoverageError.description: The address district is not (or no longer) covered. On book: release the hold and show in-zone alternatives (KX-09 §08).

CarePlanRequest.description: DRAFT (phase P3, Nurse edition). Narrowest shape; subject to change until ratified.

requestRef.description: Idempotency key; a replay returns the original response.

carePlanId.description: Set once the provider confirms (CARE_PLAN_CONFIRMED event).

AcquisitionBlock.description: Attribution evidence produced by the Kiorex deterministic decision function. Covered by the request HMAC like the rest of the body; evidenceHash is the sha256 inputsHash of the stored decision so the Clinic can later fetch and compare the evidence. The Clinic stores it, never recomputes it, and may only use it to REMOVE a commission (PROVIDER_LED), never to add one. Absent = UNATTRIBUTED and today's rules apply unchanged.

policyVersion.description: Version id of the ATTRIBUTION_POLICY that was ACTIVE at decision time.

reason.description: EXPLICIT_PROVIDER_CHANNEL, PRIOR_PROVIDER_TOUCH, PATIENT_REFERRAL, MARKETPLACE_TOUCH, NO_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE. Receivers must tolerate unknown codes.

evidenceHash.description: sha256 hex of the canonical decision inputs (see computeAttributionInputsHash in @kiorex/contracts).

touch.description: The winning touch, when there is one. Opaque ref: never a visitor key, IP, or patient identifier.

kind.description: Source kind: PROVIDER_LINK, PROVIDER_QR, WIDGET, ORGANIC_SEARCH, DIRECT, REFERRAL, CAMPAIGN, WHATSAPP, OFFLINE.

AcquisitionError.description: Malformed acquisition block. A well-formed block from an older or newer Kiorex is never an error; unknown reason codes are accepted.

orgRef.description: Organisation (tenant) reference; the same value the signed `lt` carries as `o`.

clinicRef.description: Clinic the link belongs to, when scoped to one.

status.description: A PAUSED or REVOKED link never makes a new booking provider-led.

SponsoredDiscountBlock.description: Optional block on POST /bookings (1.12.0). The Clinic re-checks the reservation it issued; a booking without a valid reservation is created without the discount, never refused.

Tender.description: How a booking amount was funded (1.12.0). Minor units. No patient identity.

patientRef.description: Opaque keyed hash. Never the Passport sub, a phone or a name.
